notes: Every section is shown to everyone. 'Depth' questions (show_if.depth_question_for) are shown only if that pillar is a focus pillar, or if the member chose 'I'm not sure yet'.
The eating-pattern grid in the v6 document is split here into eat_vegetables_fruit, eat_protein_meals, eat_home_cooked and eat_frequency; render them as one grid.
Mood, alcohol, falls and long-term sleep problems are not asked here; the Pilot asks them at the pre-Span interview.
Under-18s are excluded at sign-up, not by the assessment.
